datasets.title: Malawi Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Malawi Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/malawi_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Malawi in 2021 to assess acute food insecurity conditions. Survey data were classified using the IPC framework and spatially mapped to administrative or livelihood zones, producing monthly geographic datasets of food insecurity phase classifications.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas.
